params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Smolder''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of {{as|''Dragon Practice''|buzzword3}} each time he hits an enemy champion with an {{tip|ability}}, or whenever ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. His basic abilities deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on stacks.
* ''{{ai|Q|Smolder}}'': Deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|25 to 60|0 to 35|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|W|Smolder}}'': Explosions deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|55% of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
* ''{{ai|E|Smolder}}'': Attacks each deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{critical damage|8 to 14|0 to 6|critScaling=true}} {{as|of ''Dragon Practice'' stacks|buzzword3}}.
params.notes:
* {{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}} grants a stack if the target dies while the initial missile is in flight.
** This happens even if the target dies to {{ais|Super Scorcher Breath 3|Smolder|Super Scorcher Breath}} burn, giving him a total of 2 stacks.
* {{ai|Achooo!|Smolder}} can only grant a stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} with the first hit against each enemy champion.
* {{ai|Flap, Flap, Flap|Smolder}} can only grant one stack of {{as|Dragon Practice|buzzword3}} per cast.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Smolder}} generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Dragon Practice'' from damaging champions with abilities, or when ''{{ai|Super Scorcher Breath|Smolder}}'' kills {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}. His {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on stacks.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' spits a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 75|critScaling=true}}; applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects; applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness; and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects. If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' kills at least one target, '''Smolder''' restores {{sti|{{as|15 mana}}}}.
params.description2: ''Super Scorcher Breath'' becomes empowered with new effects based on the number of ''{{as|{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks|buzzword3}}'':
params.description3: {{sbc|Tier 1 - 25 stacks:}} The fireball explodes upon collision to deal the same {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. The explosion benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
params.description4: {{sbc|Tier 2 - 125 stacks:}} The fireball sends forth 2 {{as|(+ {{fd|0.8}} per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts of fire in an arc upon collision that explode at maximum range, dealing {{ap|0.5*100}}% of the same damage to enemies hit. The bolts benefit from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
params.description5: {{sbc|Tier 3 - 225 stacks:}} Enemies hit are set on fire for 3 seconds, causing them to take {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} equal to{{ft|{{as|{{fd|2.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.5}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as|of their '''maximum''' health}} over the duration, capped at 300 against monsters.|{{as|{{ap|2.5/3|round=2}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD}} {{as|(+ {{ap|0.5/3|round=2}}% per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} {{as| of their '''maximum''' health}} each second, capped at {{ap|300/3}} per tick against monsters.}}Subsequent applications of the burn stack, though not refreshing the duration of the previous burn. Enemy {{tip|champions}} afflicted with the burn are also {{tip|execute|executed}} once '''Smolder''' deals damage to them that would leave them below {{as|{{fd|6.5}}% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
params.target range: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|{{ccd|Smolder|range}} (+ 100% '''bonus''' {{sti|attack range}})|Always equal to Smolder's attack range}}
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|285|Tier 1 explosion}}|{{tt|150|Tier 2 missile explosions at max range}}}}
params.cast time: {{as|100% of '''Smolder's''' windup time|as}} ({{ap|(1/{{ccd|Smolder|as_base}})*{{ccd|Smolder|windup}}|round=3}} at {{as|'''base''' attack speed}})
params.notes:
* Any applied ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' damage is affected by the same damage modifiers as ''Super Scorcher Breath'' and does not benefit from the ability's {{sti|life steal}}.
* ''Super Scorcher Breath's'' damage tags:
** The fireball deals {{tip|spell damage}} and procs {{tip|basic damage}} required effects.
** The explosion deals {{tip|area damage}}.
** The burn deals {{tip|proc damage}}.
* Only '''Smolder's''' damage counts for triggering the execute.
** If the target is below the threshold while afflicted with the burn, they will be executed on the next instance of damage dealt by '''Smolder''', which includes the burn tick.
* If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' would damage the target to below the execution threshold, they are executed on the same damage instance.
* The number of additional bolts launched based on {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks is rounded up.{{bug|2}}
** At 125 {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks, the fireball will launch 3 bolts.
* At 225 {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks, the burn's damage based on the target's health ratio will increase by at least {{fd|1.125}}%.
* ''Super Scorcher Breath'' can only hit enemies once per cast.
* The minion and monster damage modifier applies only to the physical damage.
* ''Super Scorcher Breath's'' initial fireball, explosion and extra bolts can all be {{tip|block|blocked}} and {{tip|dodge|dodged}}.
** The application of the burn is negated in all cases.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Smolder}} spits a fireball that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the target enemy.
params.blurb2:
''Super Scorcher Breath'' becomes empowered with new effects based ''{{as|{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks|buzzword3}}'':
* {{sbc|25 stacks:}} The fireball explodes upon collision to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
* {{sbc|125 stacks:}} The fireball sends forth bolts of fire that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. The number of bolts increases based on stacks.
* {{sbc|225 stacks:}} Enemies hit will burn for {{as|true damage}} based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}} over a short time. Enemy {{WRtip|champions}} are also {{tip|execute|executed}} {{as|at low health}} based on stacks.
params.blurb4: ''Super Scorcher Breath'' applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' sneezes a fiery glob in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 35% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, slowing down in missile speed after travelling {{tt|1200|estimated}} units. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} creates an explosion that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, with subsequent explosions against the same target dealing 75% damage of the previous explosion's damage.
params.notes:
* '''Smolder''' can't declare basic attacks for a brief moment after the cast time.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block either the glob or the explosion, but not both.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Smolder}} sneezes forth a glob that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} creates an explosion that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' takes flight for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|unobstructed vision}}, and the ability to ignore terrain collision. While in flight, he automatically fires up to 5 {{as|(+ 1 per 100 ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' stacks)|buzzword3}} bolts at the nearest and {{tt|most wounded|Lowest health percent}} {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each hit and prioritizing enemy champions.

params.description2: ''Flap, Flap, Flap'' ends immediately if '''Smolder''' casts another ability or becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}.
params.notes:
* The number of additional bolts based on {{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}} stacks is rounded down.
* '''Smolder''' reveals himself while attacking enemies, even inside terrain.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block only one bolt.
* Self {{tip|immobilize|immobilizations}} such as {{ii|Zhonya's Hourglass}} also count for ending ''Flap, Flap, Flap''.
* {{si|Recall}} is disabled while '''Smolder''' is inside terrain.
* ''Flap, Flap, Flap'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* If '''Smolder''' is inside terrain when the effect ends, he will be placed correspondingly to the nearest valid space.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Smolder''' is flying:
{{ct|attack=Causes '''Smolder''' to move towards the attack target.|cast=interrupts|move=true|items==true,,interrupts|spells=true|interrupts=death,root}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Smolder}} takes flight for a short time, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and the ability to ignore terrain collision. While in flight, he automatically fires bolts at a nearby enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} with each hit. The number of attacks increases based on {{sti|{{as|critical strike chance}}}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Smolder''' shouts for his mother to attack from above, causing her to exhale a wave of fire starting from behind him and towards the target direction, granting {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the center part goes through that brush}} as it travels. The wave {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Smolder''' and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, with those in the center taking {{ccs|50% increased damage|physical}} and becoming {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 40% for 2 seconds.
params.width: {{tt|125|Wave center sweetspot for the increased damage}}

The wave {{as|{{sti|heals}}|heal}} '''Smolder''' and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, enemies within the center are dealt {{ccs|increased damage|physical}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
